svg.text: Honest visuals: four misleading and honest pairs
Concept 9 · scale, gaps, status colors, and stale numbers · the numbers in this picture are only examples
Gauges: the scale must be written
without a scale, the arc is measured
against its own value → always full
the simulator was off for 2 minutes,
but a straight line looks like data
7 days: > 1.5 × bucket width) = a null point
Status colors always come with text
red and green only: hard to tell apart
the color always comes with text:
the connection dropped, but the old
the card is faded and labeled;
in the List and Details: · stale data
Also honest: a unit on every number (°C, %, light 0–4095); null is written as —, not 0; the temperature axis may start above 0
if its unit is written; chart animation is off (isAnimationActive={false}), so a new number doesn't "slide" in from the old value.
